deploy-bot: Deploy v1.18.3 to prod started. Canary groups: us-west1 10%, eu-central1 5%. Post-deploy smoke suite queued: synthetic_kv, healthcheck, embed_sanity. run_id=deploy-1784507890
marie: starting synthetic_kv against canary in us-west1 :eyes:
kai: tailing kv-proxy logs now, will call out any errors
deploy-bot: synthetic_kv (us-west1): GET /kv/ping latency=24ms status=200
deploy-bot: synthetic_embed (us-west1): POST /embed OK qps=5
oncall-bot: alert: synthetic_kv failure 1/3 attempts (timeout 5s) in eu-central1
jason: wait eu-central1 is in the canary set? thought only us-west1 was 10%
olivia: we staged eu at 5% for geo cutovers, tiny fraction. rolling back eu canary to 0% while we investigate
marie: logs show `rpc deadline exceeded` from proxy->kv-store in eu region, seeing a retry storm in the client
kai: pushing small client-side backoff patch to the canary group (will flip config flag)
marie: rerunning synthetic_kv after patch, run_id=run-1784508010
deploy-bot: run-1784508010 results: eu-central1 synthetic_kv success 3/3, latency median=210ms (prev median ~190ms)
marie: bumping eu canary back to 10% and monitoring for 10m
olivia: can we hold broader rollout? i'd prefer to keep at 10% until next change window :hand:
jason: agree, hold at 10% and open a follow-up ticket, will update release notes
marie: created ticket INF-7283 with logs, span traces, and probe graphs
deploy-bot: Canary health summary: us-west1 OK; eu-central1 degraded briefly, recovered after client-backoff mitigation. planned 10%->50% bump paused
marie: TL;DR: no rollback, brief mitigation applied, holding rollout. marking post-deploy smoke as PASS with caveat
kai: :thumbsup: i'll watch kv tail for 30m and escalate if anything spikes
oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: re-check smoke probes in 15m
olivia: adding note to release notes: "v1.18.3 - staged rollout paused after transient eu kv latency; mitigation applied; monitoring ongoing"
